messages:
deploy-bot: finished rollout driver-525.60 -> a100-ampere pool (us-west-2) at 2025-02-14T15:02:12Z :white_check_mark:
aj: heads-up — we started seeing P2P failures after the rollout. NCCL logs show peer access errors and forced PCIe fallback on some machines.
aj: sample log snippet:
```
NCCL WARN CPU 0: Unreachable peer GPU 1 from GPU 0, p2p disabled, fallback to pcie
ncclCommInitRank failed: Unreachable Peer
```
kai: thanks, saw same. I’ve isolated 3 racks where BAR1 mappings look smaller than expected after the driver+kernel bump.
mira: measured BAR1 aperture on one node: used `lspci -v` and `setpci` probes — reported MV of ~256M instead of expected ~4G. That explains large memcpy fallbacks.
sasha: quick theory — kernel change in 6.5.x tightened PCIe ACS/AF rules and driver 525.60 defaults to BAR1 truncation for some BIOS combos. There was a similar upstream report last month.
ops-bot: alert: cluster capacity impacted: 42 pods degraded, 9 jobs falling back to host-gathering tiers. Autoscaler spike noted.
aj: immediate ask — can we (A) temporarily mark affected nodes unsched, (B) roll back driver on a small canary, and (C) create a repro harness? Ideas?
kai: I can cordon the 3 racks and drain low-priority jobs. Rolling back whole pool is aggressive; propose rollback of one rack first to confirm.
mira: created a quick repro script to run NCCL tests across peers and dump `lspci -vvv` and `dmesg` to S3: s3://redwood-debug/1768751234/repro.tar.gz
sasha: also checked BIOS: some hosts had `ACS override` disabled earlier; the new kernel enforces stricter isolation which causes BAR1 to be treated smaller. Short-term we can set kernel arg `pci=assign-busses`? Not ideal.
aj: ops: please cordon racks a, b. kai do the rollback to driver 525.45 on rack a only and run the repro. If p2p restores, we have a clear regression path.
kai: starting cordon now. ping me if autoscaler pins pods.
ops-bot: cordon completed for racks a,b at 15:22 UTC. Low-prio pods drained: 28.
kai: rolling back driver 525.45 -> rack a. Will post results in ~10m.
deploy-bot: rollback job queued (driver=525.45) -> rack a
kai: rollback finished. Ran repro: NCCL p2p test passes across GPUs, BAR1 reported ~4G again on the nodes I downgraded.
mira: confirmed differences in `lspci -vvv` between downgraded and upgraded hosts — upgraded hosts show "Region 2: Memory at ... [size=256M]" while downgraded show size=4G.
sasha: filing driver/kernel bug with vendor. In the meantime, propose three mitigations:
  - revert pool rollout (slow) or roll forward with kernel parameter tweak (risk)
  - mark nodes with mismatched BAR1 as unsched until vendor patch
  - add a fitness check to our rollout job to verify BAR1 aperture & NCCL smoke tests
aj: +1 to adding the BAR1 check to the rollout pipeline. Opening a follow-up ticket for rollout gate.
ops-bot: ticket created: INFRA-2132 "BAR1 aperture check + NCCL smoke in driver rollout" assigned to eng-infra.
aj: timeline: keep rollback to rack a for now, stop further rollouts. Sasha — coordinate with vendor and request hotfix or clear guidance. Kai/Mira — expand the rollback to any rack that fails the BAR1 smoke.
kai: will run a cluster-wide BAR1 scan overnight and surface failures in the ticket.
mira: logging exact repro commands in ticket. Also adding small perf impact report — estimated 7% GPU throughput loss when forced to PCIe.
sasha: sharing vendor bug ref once open. For long term, add a kernel-driver compatibility test in our CI before any fleet rollout.
aj: thanks team — good catch. We'll reconvene in the morning for next steps. :thumbsup:
